headline: Come up tired.
Go home lighter.
description: Roamstead Collective is a small group of homes across Utah's Wasatch Back, rooted in Heber Valley.
Pick your base. The mountains do the rest.

intro.title: Book with the locals who run it
intro.body: Book direct and you'll always get our best price. You also talk to us, not a call center, so questions about parking or the best powder day get a real answer.

pillars.title: Gather round
pillars.body: A table for everyone, a fire to sit around, and a plan for tomorrow. The best trips leave room for people.

pillars.title: Four seasons, no off-season
pillars.body: Winter powder. Summer singletrack. Fall color. Even mud season, and we mean that. Every week up here is a good one.

pillars.title: Local by nature
pillars.body: We send you to the bakery, the bike shop, and the river outfitter down the road. The valley's best parts are run by our neighbors.

properties.intro: From a studio at the base of Park City Mountain to a Midway home that sleeps 10, each stay has its own setting and its own reason to come back.

hero.headline: Homes for people who roam
hero.body: Roamstead Collective started in Heber Valley and has grown across the Wasatch Back. Every home is different. The rule is the same:

hooks.hygge-house: Room for 10. Cozy enough to earn the name.
hooks.granary: A quiet Midway base for 2 to 4. The kitchen island does a lot of work.
hooks.lowell: At the base of Park City Mountain. Boots on, lift next.
hooks.powder-room: Yes, it's called the Powder Room. Yes, it's for skiers. A studio inside the Lowell building.

senator.headline: Old bones, new comforts
senator.body: A historic red sandstone Victorian with rooms you book one at a time. Breakfast's on us.

community.headline: For people who come back
community.body: We're building a membership for the 4-Seasoners, the people who'd rather know one place well than see a new one every trip. Get on the early list and you'll hear first when it opens.
community.perks: What we're planning: member rates on stays, deals for valley locals, first invites to events, and a newsletter worth opening.
